newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-ALL BLACKS CRUSH FIJI IN TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ALL BLACKS CRUSH FIJI IN TEST.

text.p: New Zealand thrashed Fiji 71-5 in a one-off test on Saturday with the All Blacks' Jeff Wilson scoring five tries.
But the All Blacks' delight was tempered with concern about veteran Michael Jones who was taken off on a stretcher with a knee injury.
Jones, who has loomed large in international rugby for 10 years, was taken to hospital for emergency surgery.
Fiji had to play with 14 men in the final quarter after prop Bill Cavubati was sent off for a dangerous shoulder charge.
The tourists were never really allowed into the match as New Zealand dominated possession and Fiji's rare opportunities were thwarted by handling errors.
Comfortably ahead 45-5 at half-time, New Zealand eased off the pressure in the second half, taking the opportunity to give several new players a run.
Fiji, although clearly the underdogs, were disappointed by the size of the loss.
"You can't win without the ball. I'm really disappointed, we've got a lot of work to do between now and next week when we play Tonga," captain Greg Smith said.
Fiji's only try came after Jonetani Waqa broke through the defence in the 13th minute and sent Sale Sorovaki into New Zealand territory.
Sorovaki kicked the ball behind the All Blacks defence for right winger Fero Lasagavibau to run through and force the ball for a try.

New Zealand - Christian Cullen, Jeff Wilson, Frank Bunce, Tana Umaga, Lee Stensness, Andrew Mehrtens, Justin Marshall, Taine Randell, Josh Kronfeld, Ian Jones, Robin Brooke, Michael Jones, Olo Brown, Sean Fitzpatrick (captain) Craig Dowd.

Fiji - Filipe Rayasi, Jonetani Waqa, Fero Lasagavibau, Manasa Bari, Sale Sorovaki, Jacob Rauluni, Mosese Rauluni, Eparama Tuvinavono, Api Naevo, Iferemi Tawake, Emori Katalau, Bill Cavubati, Mosese Taga, Greg Smith (captain), Epil Naituivau.
